args.title: Juniper Labware — Warehouse automation in 2026
args.body:
• Juniper Labware’s latest newsletter highlights its “Warehouse automation in 2026” article and points active-project readers to a matching companion case study.
• The article reports that autonomous carts increased warehouse pick rates by 18%, although integration took twice as long as planned.
• The companion piece says the largest cost saving came from reducing mis-picks.
